message:
♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.2.2 IS LIVE! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

Version 9.2.2 brings more accurate AutoCaptions, Halftone Wave and new SaaS Effects tools, and fixes Un-Precomp freezing After Effects on big selections.

*(Install over your current version with your ZXP installer and restart After Effects once to apply the update.)*

♦️ **Un-Precomp Fix**
* **No More Freezes Or Crashes:** Selected precomps are now done one at a time, with a counter. Press Esc to stop. Each precomp is its own undo step.

♦️ **AutoCaptions**
* **New Look & Name:** The same clean layout as Flex Ultimate, now called AUTOCAPTIONS (no longer Beta), right under Silence Remover.
* **No More Missing Sentences:** Music or noise under the voice no longer makes whole sentences disappear.
* **Better Language Detection:** It listens to several parts of the clip, not just the first 30 seconds.
* **Hinglish:** Comes out in Roman letters with English words kept in English, and is much more accurate.
* **Translate To English:** Offline, with Large V3 or Medium.
* **Shorter Model List:** Large V3 Turbo, Large V3 and Medium. Captions now run fully on your machine (Flex AI cloud captions are off for now).

♦️ **SaaS Effects**
* **Halftone Wave:** A ring of dots ripples out from the selected layer, clipped inside it, all on one control layer.
* **New Tools:** Bounce Stagger, Cursor Styles (arrow, hand, dot), Colour Typing, Proximity Hover, UI Carousel, Attach Layer and an AI Prompt Bar.
* **Background:** Horizon and Stars styles, a Violet palette, and clip-to-layer.
